messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: realtime-latency-detector triggered: p99 spike on hosted-api-prod (metric_id=latency.p99). alert threshold crossed at 2026-03-15T08:13:09Z. Paging SRE oncall
oncall-bot: incident ticket created INC-2026-042. Initial severity: P1.
annie: acked — I'm on call. pulling up dashboards now. @mira you good to join?
sam: looking... dashboards show p95 jumped ~200ms -> ~650ms; p99 from ~900ms -> ~2.1s in last 6m. spike started ~08:11Z.
mira: joining. any customer reports?
annie: support mentioned timeouts for a customer realtime chat room — CS says several users saw stalled streaming.
julian: I rolled a runtime hotfix 5m ago to change kernel selection heuristics (rollout 10% -> 100% over 5m). Could be related.
annie: good to know. sam, can you quick-check distribution by model and region?
sam: running queries now. promql: sum by(region,model)(rate(requests_total[5m])) and histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le,region,model) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
sam: results: eu-west-1 / long-context models show worst p99 ~2.3s; us-west-2 moderate ~1.2s; small models mostly fine. request rate steady.
mira: sounds like kernel selection change impacting long-context paths. any error spikes?
sam: logs: increased KV cache misses and GC stalls on GPU nodes in the serving pool. grep shows repeated warnings: "kv_cache_resync: miss_rate=0.84"
annie: can we validate traffic routing? maybe some traffic spilled to cpu fallback nodes. ops-bot: routing debug dump: 86% routed to gpu-pool-3, 14% to cpu-fallbacks in eu-west-1.
annie: cpu fallbacks explain higher p99 for long runs. mitigation plan: 1) roll back kernel-selection rollout to previous version 2) temporarily increase dedicated gpu burst for hosted-prod 3) enable prefix-KV-cache strict mode for long-context models 4) notify customers about degraded performance. who can rollback?
mira: I can stop the rollout. running infractl rollout abort --service=kernel-picker --env=prod --id=2026-03-15-ker01
sam: while that's in progress, can we enable fallback model option? command: infractl feature-toggle set hosted-api degrade_to_small_model=true --scope=global
julian: rolling back now. rollback command executed at 08:16:24Z. watching.
annie: I'm increasing autoscale burst for dedicated pool: infractl capacity set dedicated-gpu-pool-3 --burst=+30%
annie: also toggled prefix_cache.strict=true for long-context models.
sam: observing metrics: p99 dropping from 2.1s -> 1.4s within 2m of rollback start. p95 trending down too.
mira: any customer-visible error counts?
sam: error_rate isn't up significantly; timeouts persistent for streaming clients because they held open connections during stall. new streams success rate improving.
annie: action items: mira validating rollback effect and capacity change; sam to run a targeted replay of long-context workload on canary to confirm fix; julian to investigate why kernel-picker increased KV misses; annie will coordinate comms.
mira: taking lead for mitigation and handoff. If p99 < 1s for 10m, we'll de-escalate.
ops-bot: paging note: on-call rotation notified: SRE oncall (mira) now assigned.
sam: running replay job: curl -s "https://internal-replay/run?profile=long_context&rate=50" -I -> started 08:20Z. preliminary results: latency stable ~850ms p99 on canary.
julian: digging into rollout diff: changed kernel lookup fallback order (added heuristic for seq_len>1024). looks like heuristic forced a path that increases KV resync frequency. reverting change to heuristic logic.
annie: good. PS: customer-impact estimate: ~12% of hosted requests experienced >500ms regression, streaming stalls affected ~0.8% of active websocket sessions for ~2-6m window. notifying CS to reach out to top-affected tenants.
mira: status update to incident channel in 10m. if rollback doesn't fully remediate, plan B is to divert long-context traffic to a dedicated long-run pool (warm nodes) or enable model quantization fallback per request.
sam: also capturing traces for affected traces: trace IDs collected and sent to /incidents/INC-2026-042/traces.
annie: any lasting errors in infra? disk/GPU memory looks fine. KV cache miss rate back to baseline after rollback.
julian: I own the bugfix PR, will block kernel-picker rollouts until we have a regression test for kv-miss tolerance.
mira: handing off to post-incident: sam will be postmortem lead; julian bug owner; annie communications. I'll remain on follow-up for 2h.
annie: thanks team. closing live mitigation — monitoring for 20m then de-escalate. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 updated: status=mitigated, mitigations=[rollback_kernel_picker, increased_burst_capacity, prefix_cache_strict]. next steps filed in ticket.
annie: filing quick RCA notes and assigning postmortem.
